mapper.sql: ib.order_sn IS NOT NULL AND ib.order_sn <> '' AND ib.create_time IS NOT NULL AND ib.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND ib.status IN (20, 40) AND ibi.product_total IS NOT NULL AND ibi.product_total >= 0

CASE WHEN pofr.sent_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pofr.sent_at, COALESCE(pofr.completion_at, #{query.asOf})) END AS delivery_hours, CASE WHEN pofr.sent_at IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' WHEN pofr.completion_at IS NOT NULL AND pofr.completion_at <= DATE_ADD(pofr.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'COMPLETED_WITHIN_SLA' WHEN pofr.completion_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA' WHEN #{query.asOf} >= DATE_ADD(pofr.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE' ELSE 'IN_TRANSIT' END AS delivery_status, CASE WHEN pofr.completion_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN pofr.has_inbound = 1 AND pofr.completion_at IS NULL THEN 'IB_CREATE' WHEN pofr.has_receipt = 1 AND pofr.has_inbound = 0 THEN 'CR_RECEIPT' WHEN pofr.status = 3 THEN 'PO_CREATE' WHEN pofr.status = 121 THEN 'PO_APPROVAL' WHEN pofr.status = 1 THEN 'SUPPLIER_SENT' WHEN pofr.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND pofr.settlement_method = 7 AND pofr.has_receipt = 0 THEN 'FINANCE_PAYMENT' ELSE CAST(NULL AS CHAR) END AS current_node, CASE WHEN pofr.completion_at IS NOT NULL THEN 9 WHEN pofr.has_inbound = 1 AND pofr.completion_at IS NULL THEN 8 WHEN pofr.has_receipt = 1 AND pofr.has_inbound = 0 THEN 7 WHEN pofr.status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN pofr.status = 121 THEN 4 WHEN pofr.status = 1 THEN 5 WHEN pofr.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND pofr.settlement_method = 7 AND pofr.has_receipt = 0 THEN 6 ELSE CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) END AS node_rank

, filtered_plan_projection AS ( SELECT fro.plan_sn, COUNT(DISTINCT pof.order_sn) AS related_order_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pof.order_sn ORDER BY pof.order_sn SEPARATOR '||') AS order_sns, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pof.buyer), '') ORDER BY pof.buyer SEPARATOR '||') AS buyers, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pof.supplier), '') ORDER BY pof.supplier SEPARATOR '||') AS suppliers, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pof.warehouse), '') ORDER BY pof.warehouse SEPARATOR '||') AS warehouses FROM filtered_relation_orders fro INNER JOIN po_facts_lite pof ON pof.order_sn = fro.order_sn GROUP BY fro.plan_sn )

sql.if: AND ( pf.plan_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pf.sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pf.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pf.pp_supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders risk_rel INNER JOIN po_facts_lite risk_po ON risk_po.order_sn = risk_rel.order_sn WHERE risk_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn AND risk_po.delivery_status IN ('IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA') )

mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN pf.order_timeliness = 'OVERDUE' AND COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') <> 'COMPLETED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') <> 'COMPLETED' AND pf.delivery_status IN ('IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') = 'COMPLETED' THEN 3 WHEN pf.order_timeliness = 'OVERDUE' THEN 0 WHEN pf.delivery_status IN ('IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
CASE WHEN pf.current_node = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.order_lead_hours DESC, pf.max_delivery_hours DESC, pf.achievement_rate ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
pf.created_at DESC, pf.plan_sn DESC
pf.order_lead_hours pf.max_delivery_hours pf.achievement_rate
ASC DESC
, pf.plan_sn ASC
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_facts pf WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT pf.plan_sn, pf.product_name, pf.sku, pf.status_text, pf.approval_status, pf.created_at, pf.approval_at, pf.plan_qty, pf.purchase_qty,
COALESCE(fpp.related_order_count, 0) AS related_order_count, fpp.order_sns, fpp.buyers, fpp.suppliers, fpp.warehouses,
pf.related_order_count, pf.order_sns, pf.buyers, pf.suppliers, pf.warehouses,
pf.last_po_created_at, pf.order_lead_hours, pf.order_timeliness, pf.order_coverage_confirmed, pf.current_node, pf.max_delivery_hours, pf.delivery_status, pf.allocation_available, pf.inbound_qty, pf.achievement_rate, pf.returned_qty, pf.exchange_qty FROM plan_facts pf
LEFT JOIN filtered_plan_projection fpp ON fpp.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn
WHERE 1 = 1
LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT DISTINCT po.opt_realname FROM lx_purchase_order po INNER JOIN lx_pp_po_sku_ass ass ON ass.order_sn = po.order_sn INNER JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = ass.plan_sn WHERE po.status NOT IN (-1, 124) AND po.create_time IS NOT NULL AND po.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND pp.status NOT IN (-3, 122, 124) AND pp.create_time IS NOT NULL AND pp.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND po.opt_realname IS NOT NULL AND po.opt_realname <> '' ORDER BY po.opt_realname

SELECT DISTINCT po.supplier_name FROM lx_purchase_order po INNER JOIN lx_pp_po_sku_ass ass ON ass.order_sn = po.order_sn INNER JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = ass.plan_sn WHERE po.status NOT IN (-1, 124) AND po.create_time IS NOT NULL AND po.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND pp.status NOT IN (-3, 122, 124) AND pp.create_time IS NOT NULL AND pp.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND po.supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND po.supplier_name <> '' ORDER BY po.supplier_name

SELECT DISTINCT po.ware_house_name FROM lx_purchase_order po INNER JOIN lx_pp_po_sku_ass ass ON ass.order_sn = po.order_sn INNER JOIN lx_purchase_plan pp ON pp.plan_sn = ass.plan_sn WHERE po.status NOT IN (-1, 124) AND po.create_time IS NOT NULL AND po.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND pp.status NOT IN (-3, 122, 124) AND pp.create_time IS NOT NULL AND pp.create_time <= #{query.asOf} AND po.ware_house_name IS NOT NULL AND po.ware_house_name <> '' ORDER BY po.ware_house_name
mapper.sql: pof.order_id, pof.order_sn, #{planSn} AS plan_sn, pof.skus, pof.product_names, pof.status_text, pof.supplier, pof.warehouse, pof.buyer, pof.settlement_method, pof.settlement_type, pof.source_type, pof.created_at, pof.approval_at, pof.sent_at, COALESCE(ppit.purchase_qty, 0) AS purchase_qty, pof.receipt_sns, pof.receipt_count, pof.inbound_sns, pof.inbound_count, COALESCE(ppibt.valid_inbound_qty, 0) AS valid_inbound_qty, ppc.completion_inbound_sn, ppc.completion_at, pof.delivery_hours, pof.delivery_status, pof.current_node, CASE WHEN poa.allocation_available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allocation_available, CASE WHEN poa.allocation_available = 1 THEN poa.allocated_qty ELSE NULL END AS allocated_qty

sql.if: AND ( rel.plan_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.order_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.skus LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.product_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.receipt_sns LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.inbound_sns LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts pof ON pof.order_sn = rel.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_sku_completion ppc ON ppc.plan_sn = rel.plan_sn AND ppc.order_sn = rel.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_item_totals ppit ON ppit.plan_sn = rel.plan_sn AND ppit.order_sn = rel.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_inbound_totals ppibt ON ppibt.plan_sn = rel.plan_sn AND ppibt.order_sn = rel.order_sn LEFT JOIN plan_order_allocation poa ON poa.plan_sn = rel.plan_sn AND poa.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn}
ORDER BY pof.created_at ASC, pof.order_sn ASC

SELECT CONCAT(rel.plan_sn, '::', pof.order_id, '::', COALESCE(HEX(psf.sku), 'NO_SKU')) AS row_key, pof.order_id AS order_id, pof.order_sn AS order_sn, rel.plan_sn AS plan_sn, psf.sku AS sku, psf.product_name AS product_name, pof.status_text AS status_text, pof.supplier AS supplier, pof.warehouse AS warehouse, pof.buyer AS buyer, pof.settlement_method AS settlement_method, pof.settlement_type AS settlement_type, pof.source_type AS source_type, pof.created_at AS created_at, pof.approval_at AS approval_at, pof.sent_at AS sent_at, psf.line_qty AS purchase_qty, COALESCE(osrs.receipt_sns, '') AS receipt_sns, COALESCE(osrs.receipt_count, 0) AS receipt_count, COALESCE(osrs.receipt_qty, 0) AS receipt_qty, COALESCE(osis.inbound_sns, '') AS inbound_sns, COALESCE(osis.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count, COALESCE(osis.valid_inbound_qty, 0) AS valid_inbound_qty, pof.completion_inbound_sn AS po_completion_inbound_sn, pof.completion_at AS po_completion_at, psf.completion_inbound_sn AS sku_completion_inbound_sn, psf.completion_at AS sku_completion_at, pof.delivery_hours AS po_delivery_hours, pof.delivery_status AS po_delivery_status, CASE WHEN pof.sent_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pof.sent_at, COALESCE(psf.completion_at, #{query.asOf})) END AS sku_delivery_hours, CASE WHEN pof.sent_at IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' WHEN psf.completion_at IS NOT NULL AND psf.completion_at <= DATE_ADD(pof.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'COMPLETED_WITHIN_SLA' WHEN psf.completion_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA' WHEN #{query.asOf} >= DATE_ADD(pof.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE' ELSE 'IN_TRANSIT' END AS sku_delivery_status, pof.current_node AS po_current_node, 0 AS allocation_available, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS allocated_qty FROM relation_skus rel INNER JOIN po_facts pof ON pof.order_sn = rel.order_sn INNER JOIN po_sku_facts psf ON psf.order_sn = rel.order_sn AND psf.sku <=> rel.sku LEFT JOIN order_sku_receipt_summary osrs ON osrs.order_sn = rel.order_sn AND osrs.sku <=> rel.sku LEFT JOIN order_sku_ib_summary osis ON osis.order_sn = rel.order_sn AND osis.sku <=> rel.sku WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn}
ORDER BY pof.created_at ASC, pof.order_sn ASC, psf.sku ASC

SELECT pof.order_id, pof.order_sn, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rel.plan_sn ORDER BY rel.plan_sn SEPARATOR '||') FROM relation_orders rel WHERE rel.order_sn = pof.order_sn) AS plan_sn, pof.skus, pof.product_names, pof.status_text, pof.supplier, pof.warehouse, pof.buyer, pof.settlement_method, pof.settlement_type, pof.source_type, pof.created_at, pof.approval_at, pof.sent_at,
COALESCE(psf.line_qty, 0) AS purchase_qty, COALESCE(osis.valid_inbound_qty, 0) AS valid_inbound_qty, psf.completion_inbound_sn AS completion_inbound_sn, psf.completion_at AS completion_at, COALESCE(osis.inbound_sns, '') AS inbound_sns, COALESCE(osis.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count, CASE WHEN pof.sent_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pof.sent_at, COALESCE(psf.completion_at, #{query.asOf})) END AS delivery_hours, CASE WHEN pof.sent_at IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' WHEN psf.completion_at IS NOT NULL AND psf.completion_at <= DATE_ADD(pof.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'COMPLETED_WITHIN_SLA' WHEN psf.completion_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA' WHEN #{query.asOf} >= DATE_ADD(pof.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE' ELSE 'IN_TRANSIT' END AS delivery_status,
COALESCE(ppit.purchase_qty, 0) AS purchase_qty, COALESCE(ppibt.valid_inbound_qty, 0) AS valid_inbound_qty, ppc.completion_inbound_sn AS completion_inbound_sn, ppc.completion_at AS completion_at, COALESCE(ppibs.inbound_sns, '') AS inbound_sns, COALESCE(ppibs.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count, CASE WHEN pof.sent_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pof.sent_at, COALESCE(ppc.completion_at, #{query.asOf})) END AS delivery_hours, CASE WHEN pof.sent_at IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' WHEN ppc.completion_at IS NOT NULL AND ppc.completion_at <= DATE_ADD(pof.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'COMPLETED_WITHIN_SLA' WHEN ppc.completion_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA' WHEN #{query.asOf} >= DATE_ADD(pof.sent_at, INTERVAL 360 HOUR) THEN 'IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE' ELSE 'IN_TRANSIT' END AS delivery_status,
COALESCE(osrs.receipt_sns, '') AS receipt_sns, COALESCE(osrs.receipt_count, 0) AS receipt_count,
COALESCE(pprs.receipt_sns, '') AS receipt_sns, COALESCE(pprs.receipt_count, 0) AS receipt_count,
pof.current_node, CASE WHEN oa.allocation_available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allocation_available, CASE WHEN oa.allocation_available = 1 THEN oa.allocated_qty ELSE NULL END AS allocated_qty FROM po_facts pof
LEFT JOIN po_sku_facts psf ON psf.order_sn = pof.order_sn AND psf.sku <=> #{sku} LEFT JOIN order_sku_ib_summary osis ON osis.order_sn = pof.order_sn AND osis.sku <=> #{sku} LEFT JOIN order_sku_receipt_summary osrs ON osrs.order_sn = pof.order_sn AND osrs.sku <=> #{sku}
LEFT JOIN pp_po_item_totals ppit ON ppit.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND ppit.order_sn = pof.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_inbound_totals ppibt ON ppibt.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND ppibt.order_sn = pof.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_sku_completion ppc ON ppc.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND ppc.order_sn = pof.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_ib_summary ppibs ON ppibs.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND ppibs.order_sn = pof.order_sn LEFT JOIN pp_po_receipt_summary pprs ON pprs.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND pprs.order_sn = pof.order_sn
LEFT JOIN order_allocation oa ON oa.order_sn = pof.order_sn WHERE pof.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM relation_orders rel WHERE rel.order_sn = pof.order_sn )

choose.when: SELECT g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn, g.created_at, g.inbound_qty, SUM(g.inbound_qty) OVER ( ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_qty, CASE WHEN psf.completion_inbound_sn = g.inbound_sn AND psf.completion_at = g.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completion_inbound FROM ( SELECT vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at, SUM(vii.inbound_qty) AS inbound_qty FROM valid_ib_items vii WHERE vii.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND vii.sku <=> #{sku} GROUP BY vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at ) g LEFT JOIN po_sku_facts psf ON psf.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND psf.sku <=> #{sku} ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn

SELECT g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn, g.created_at, g.inbound_qty, SUM(g.inbound_qty) OVER ( ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_qty, CASE WHEN ppc.completion_inbound_sn = g.inbound_sn AND ppc.completion_at = g.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completion_inbound FROM ( SELECT vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at, SUM(vii.inbound_qty) AS inbound_qty FROM valid_ib_items vii INNER JOIN relation_skus rs ON rs.order_sn = vii.order_sn AND rs.sku <=> vii.sku WHERE rs.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND rs.order_sn = #{orderSn} GROUP BY vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at ) g LEFT JOIN pp_po_sku_completion ppc ON ppc.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND ppc.order_sn = #{orderSn} ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn
choose.otherwise: SELECT g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn, g.created_at, g.inbound_qty, SUM(g.inbound_qty) OVER ( ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_qty, CASE WHEN pc.completion_inbound_sn = g.inbound_sn AND pc.completion_at = g.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completion_inbound FROM ( SELECT vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at, SUM(vii.inbound_qty) AS inbound_qty FROM valid_ib_items vii WHERE vii.order_sn = #{orderSn} GROUP BY vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at ) g LEFT JOIN po_completion pc ON pc.order_sn = #{orderSn} ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn

mapper.select: SELECT events.* FROM () events WHERE events.event_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY events.event_time, events.event_id

SELECT events.* FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('PP_CREATE_', pp.id) AS event_id, 'PP' AS source_type, pp.plan_sn AS source_sn, pp.create_time AS event_time, 'PP创建' AS title, COALESCE(pp.status_text, '') AS description, pp.creator_real_name AS operator_name, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS quantity, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS cumulative_quantity FROM valid_pp pp WHERE pp.plan_sn = #{planSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PP_APPROVAL_', pp.id), 'PP', pp.plan_sn, pp.approval_time, 'PP审批', COALESCE(pp.approval_status, ''), pp.approver, NULL, NULL FROM valid_pp pp WHERE pp.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND pp.approval_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_CREATE_', po.id), 'PO', po.order_sn, po.create_time, 'PO创建', COALESCE(po.status_text, ''), po.opt_realname, NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN valid_po po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_APPROVAL_', po.id), 'PO', po.order_sn, po.auditor_time, 'PO审批', COALESCE(po.status_text, ''), po.auditor_realname, NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN valid_po po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND po.auditor_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_SENT_', psl.sent_log_id), 'PO', pof.order_sn, psl.sent_at, '下发供应商', COALESCE(pof.supplier, ''), COALESCE(psl.sent_operator, pof.buyer), NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts pof ON pof.order_sn = rel.order_sn INNER JOIN po_sent_log psl ON psl.order_sn = pof.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND psl.sent_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PAY_', rfo.id), 'PAYMENT', rfo.order_sn, COALESCE(CAST(rfo.real_pay_time AS DATETIME), rfo.apply_time), CASE WHEN rfo.real_pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN '付款完成' ELSE '请款' END, CONCAT('关联PO: ', rfoi.business_sn), COALESCE(rfo.pay_user, rfo.apply_user), NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN lx_request_funds_order_item rfoi ON rfoi.business_sn = rel.order_sn INNER JOIN lx_request_funds_order rfo ON rfo.order_sn = rfoi.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND rfo.status NOT IN (3, 122, 124) AND COALESCE(CAST(rfo.real_pay_time AS DATETIME), rfo.apply_time) <= #{query.asOf} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CR_', rf.receipt_id), 'CR', rf.receipt_sn, rf.created_at, 'CR收货', CONCAT('来源PO: ', rf.order_sn), rf.operator_name, NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN receipt_facts rf ON rf.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('IB_', g.inbound_id), 'IB', g.inbound_sn, g.created_at, CASE WHEN pc.completion_inbound_sn = g.inbound_sn AND pc.completion_at = g.created_at THEN 'IB创建（累计达标）' ELSE 'IB创建' END, CASE WHEN pc.completion_inbound_sn = g.inbound_sn AND pc.completion_at = g.created_at THEN '累计达到采购数量，采购流程完成' ELSE '有效入库累计未达标' END, g.operator_name, g.inbound_qty, SUM(g.inbound_qty) OVER ( PARTITION BY g.order_sn ORDER BY g.created_at, g.inbound_id, g.inbound_sn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) FROM ( SELECT vii.order_sn, vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at, MAX(vii.operator_name) AS operator_name, SUM(vii.inbound_qty) AS inbound_qty FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN valid_ib_items vii ON vii.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} GROUP BY vii.order_sn, vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.created_at ) g LEFT JOIN po_completion pc ON pc.order_sn = g.order_sn ) events WHERE events.event_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY events.event_time, events.event_id
